title: Addition and Subtraction
questionReadAloudEn: What is addition? What is subtraction?
answerReadAloudEn: Addition means combining two amounts to find the total. Subtraction means taking away or finding the difference.

title: Multiplication
questionReadAloudEn: What is multiplication? What is the multiplication version of 5 plus 5 plus 5?
answerReadAloudEn: Multiplication is repeated addition of the same number. The multiplication version of 5 plus 5 plus 5 is 3 times 5.

title: Division

title: Operation Answer Names
questionReadAloudEn: What are the names of the answers to each of these types of problems?
answerReadAloudEn: For addition the answer is the sum. For subtraction the answer is the difference. For multiplication the answer is the product. For division the answer is the quotient.

title: Graphing Coordinates
questionReadAloudEn: Explain how you can graph coordinates, like 3 comma 5.
answerReadAloudEn: Start at 0 comma 0. Move to the right 3 spaces. Then move up 5 spaces. Draw a dot there.
